summary: Initializes an embedded arithmetic-comparison sub-object at this+0x18C: stores the UIScreenStateMachine symbol pointer into sub-object word 0, clears its two byte flags, sets its active byte to 1, dispatches the object vtable init at obj+0x10, invokes the first function-table entry at this+0x190, then clears the result/completion dword at this+0x8C and returns the dispatch result.

operations.description: Load the sub-object pointer from this+0x18C.
Store the UIScreenStateMachine symbol pointer into sub-object word 0.
Clear the sub-object byte flags at +0x10 and +0x11.
Set the sub-object active/enabled byte at +0x14 to 1.
Dispatch the object vtable entry at obj+0x10 (4th entry, virtual init) with this.
Invoke the first function-table entry at this+0x190 with this and capture its result.
Clear the result/completion dword at this+0x8C to 0.
Return the result captured from the this+0x190 dispatch.
